note: Text stand-ins for the keyframes that VisualClaw's cascade gate (Cascade-8) forwards from the walkthrough clip. The adapter stages each description as _clip_frames/<MM_SS>.jpg, and the backbone receives it in place of the image attachment.

keyframes.description: Cabinet B, top shelf, door open. Nitrile gloves size M (blue Kimtech boxes): three boxes are still in clear factory shrink-wrap; two boxes have the perforated lid torn open, one about half full and one nearly full. The shelf label reads 'Gloves M'.

Cabinet B, middle shelf. 10 uL filter tip racks: one rack is still inside its sealed plastic sleeve; three racks stand without sleeves with their hinged lids open and tips missing from the front rows.
Cabinet B, bottom shelf. Bags of 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes: two bags are closed with the factory heat seal; one bag has been cut open along the top and folded over with a black binder clip.
Bench drawer 3 pulled open. 200 uL tip boxes (yellow tips): four boxes, each with the round tamper-seal sticker unbroken across the lid. No opened tip box is in the drawer.

Flammables cabinet (yellow, door open). 70% ethanol, 1 L bottles: two bottles with unbroken shrink bands over the caps at the back; one bottle with the band removed, about half full, standing at the front next to a squeeze wash bottle.

Cold room shelf 2. Tris-HCl buffer pH 8.0, 1 L glass bottles: two bottles, both with the cap seal broken and handwritten 'opened' dates on tape; one is about one-third full and one is nearly full. No sealed bottle is on the shelf.
Cabinet C, middle shelf. 10 mL serological pipettes: six packs still shrink-wrapped inside the open shipping case; one pack beside the case has been torn open and several pipettes pulled out.
Cabinet C, lower shelf. Parafilm M: one roll box still has its cellophane wrap; a second box is open with a partly used roll sticking out of the cutter slot.
